answers.question: The objective, in one sentence, and its current verdict word for the operator's thesis; which hypothesis is not adjudicable and why.
answers.answer: Objective: minimise p95 TTFT and tokens-to-verified-success over long runs at equal-or-better verified quality on occamy-1.0/SGLang :8012. There is NO verdict word for the thesis; the only recorded aggregate is the batch table (134 rows: PASS 15, FAIL 11, partial 34, author-report 73, pending 1). H1 is not adjudicable at the pinned launch shape (per-cell n=48 < 60 -> G3 exit 12; pooled n=144/96 passes G3 and is refused by G2 at 8,640/5,760 s vs 2,880 s). H3 is not adjudicable below 8 decidable of 12 checkpoints.
answers.notes: The objective is answered; the verdict word is absent. Read as: no thesis-level verdict exists, only per-hypothesis refusals. Do not read the batch aggregate as the thesis' verdict.

answers.question: The frozen thresholds that may never be lowered to make an outcome readable, and where they live.
answers.answer: 48 turns per arm (N=48); reps >= 2; the four-arm clause (all four arms in the same grid with identical fixture_sha256 and reasoning policy); TAIL_MIN = 3; p95 minimum n = 60; H3 unadjudicable below 8 of 12; the 2/12 margin; McNemar b+c >= 6 at p<0.05; the 180 s live turn wall. The 100 ms gate is a scheduling predicate, not an adjudication threshold.

answers.notes: PARM-1 is FROZEN: changes land as additive errata (docs/PARM-1-ERRATA.md), never as an edit to docs/PREREG-ARM-RUN.md.

answers.question: What a verdict row is, why most closed cards lack one, and what the gate does when it is missing.
answers.answer: A verdict row is {command, exitCode, sha} recorded for one card via orchestration_verdict; it proves one command exited with the recorded status against a named commit and nothing more. Of 134 rows only 1 is complete: 11 lack sha, 64 lack exit and sha, 58 lack all three — rows are machine-extracted from handoffs and most handoffs recorded a prose outcome rather than a command. When it is missing the row is a report, not a verdict, and the gate never saw it; tests/test_verdict_ritual.py fails on any new closure settled with no verdict row, and a settle with nothing recorded derives no-verdict.
answers.notes: The sweeper's own shipped command is tests/test_verdict_ritual.py::LiveLedgerTest::test_no_new_unverdicted_closure_since_the_baseline.
